ITEM.PTXT: Wireless hands-free calling is possible using a Bluetooth-compatible cellular phone.

HINT.PTXT: Only specified models of cellular phone can be used.

ITEM.PTXT: After a call is made or received, the conversation takes place through the voice recognition microphone and a vehicle speaker (front speaker RH).
The voice recognition microphone is a unidirectional box-type microphone and is installed at the rear of the front personal lamp.
The talk switch and telephone switch are located on the right side of the steering pad, allowing switch operation without taking the hands off the steering wheel.
